column1: # Tagalog STRESS lexicon — phonemic stress is UNWRITTEN; our rule defaults to PENULTIMATE, but ~23% of
# words stress elsewhere (mostly FINAL: balik→balík, salmon→salmón). Each entry pins the stressed VOWEL-nucleus
# index (0-based) where it differs from the penult default; sourced from kaikki tgl (single confident stress
# position, vowel-count-aligned). SHIPPED phonemizeWord applies it; phonemizeWordRules (the eval) keeps the
# penult default — but the referee folds stress, so this is a shipped-quality (TTS) improvement. See docs.
